# External dependencies of FuguBench. The fugubench deps verb
# installs each line. gitleaks publishes no OpenBSD build, and the
# ports tree holds no port for it. An operator on OpenBSD installs it
# by hand, and the secret gate of CI runs on Linux. signify(1) sits in
# base, so the signify tier of the runtime entry needs no package.

runtime dist https://github.com/FuguBSD/Fugu/releases/latest/download/Fugu.tar.gz

test pkg p5-Perl-Critic
test pkg p5-Perl-Tidy
